target.title: fix(clawrouter): sanitize attribution headers to ByteString
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where ClawRouter automatic agent/session attribution headers could include emoji or CJK characters. Fetch/`Headers` requires ByteString values, so Unicode ids throw `TypeError` before the model request is sent.

## Why This Change Was Made

`sanitizeAttributionValue` now replaces non-printable ASCII with `_` (same spirit as request-id allowlisting, without the request-id hash/suffix), then truncates to 256. Control-character rejection, trim/empty handling, and explicit operator headers are unchanged.

## User Impact

**Before:** Unicode `agentId`/`sessionId` attribution could crash request construction with a ByteString `TypeError`.
**After:** Automatic attribution headers are always printable ASCII; CR/LF values are still omitted; length cap remains 256.

## Evidence

Branch: `codex/clawrouter-attribution-bytestring` | Base: `upstream/main` @ `a5c5e3b713e7c16225394196af2cb37413f6fe22` | Head: `38e49c17dcf2` | Node: v24.18.0 — Windows

### Regression tests

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/clawrouter/index.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ ClawRouter plugin > attaches bounded attribution without overriding configured metadata
 ✓ ClawRouter plugin > sanitizes Unicode agent and session attribution to printable ASCII ByteString
 ✓ ClawRouter plugin > omits unsafe attribution header values

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  10 passed (10)
```

- Emoji/CJK agent/session ids become printable ASCII while retaining surrounding ASCII structure.
- Sanitized headers construct with `new Headers(...)` without throwing.
- Existing CR/LF omission and 256-length cap coverage remain.

### Diff summary

```text
extensions/clawrouter/stream.ts       | ByteString sanitize for attribution values
extensions/clawrouter/index.test.ts   | Unicode + Headers construction regression
```

What was not tested: ClawRouter server-side display of sanitized ids; explicit operator-supplied headers are intentionally untouched.

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed:** ClawRouter automatic agent/session attribution headers are sanitized to printable ASCII ByteString so `Headers` construction no longer throws on emoji/CJK ids.
**Environment tested:** Windows, Node v24.18.0, worktree `codex/clawrouter-attribution-bytestring` @ `38e49c17dcf2`, focused vitest exercising production `wrapClawRouterProviderStream` / `sanitizeAttributionValue` path.
**Steps run after the patch:**

1. Run `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/clawrouter/index.test.ts --reporter=verbose`.
2. Confirm Unicode agent/session ids are sanitized and `new Headers(headers)` succeeds.

**Evidence after fix:**

```text
 ✓ ClawRouter plugin > sanitizes Unicode agent and session attribution to printable ASCII ByteString
 ✓ ClawRouter plugin > omits unsafe attribution header values
 ✓ ClawRouter plugin > attaches bounded attribution without overriding configured metadata
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  10 passed (10)
```

**Observed result:** Unicode attribution values are rewritten to printable ASCII; header maps construct without ByteString `TypeError`; CR/LF values remain omitted.
**Not tested:** Live ClawRouter upstream acceptance/display of the sanitized ids; operator-supplied explicit headers remain unsanitized by design.

- [x] I understand what the code does
- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns
